tables.totals_check: Summed the eight crime rows in each column against the printed Totals. 1944 Sep: 8,831 printed, 8,831 sum, agree. 1944 Oct: 8,917 printed, 8,917 sum, agree. 1945 Sep: 5,758 printed, 5,758 sum, agree. 1945 Oct: 4,702 printed, 4,702 sum, agree. 1945 Nov: 5,653 printed, 5,653 sum, agree.
tables.ocr_check: OCR misread many digits (Robbery Nov 38 for 35, Theft Sep 1945 4,982 for 4,922, Seizing Oct 1944 191 for 181, Other Crimes Oct 1944 562 for 563, Oct 1945 127 for 137, Misc. 1944 379/372 for 979/872, Sep 1945 238 for 298, Totals 8,821 and 5,756 for 8,831 and 5,758, Incendiarism Sep 1944 and Seizing Sep 1944 read plausibly) and headings (Bokbery, Seking); all my readings reconcile with the printed totals.
